e.title: IRA（肯尼亚保险监管局）：行业统计、理赔结算统计与年报
e.title_en: IRA (Insurance Regulatory Authority, Kenya): industry statistics, claims settlement statistics and annual reports
e.title_hk: IRA（肯尼亞保險監管局）：行業統計、理賠結算統計與年報
e.summary: 东非最大保险市场的监管机构：行业统计（2025 新闻稿/PDF）、理赔结算统计查询页、年报与持牌机构名录
e.summary_en: Regulator of East Africa’s largest insurance market: industry statistics (2025 release/PDF), a claims settlement statistics page, annual reports and a licensed-entity register
e.summary_hk: 東非最大保險市場的監管機構：行業統計（2025 新聞稿/PDF）、理賠結算統計查詢頁、年報與持牌機構名錄
e.body:
**IRA（Insurance Regulatory Authority，肯尼亚保险监管局）** 是**肯尼亚的保险监管机构**——东非最大保险市场的监管者。本条目同属本轮**市场覆盖轴**：实测池内**肯尼亚及「南非以外的非洲」相关条目为 0**（仅有 [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]] 一类合成数据）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测，且逐一区分了真页面与软 404**）：首页 51KB；**「Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025」**（`/resource/press-release-industry-statistics-2025`）28.7KB，**页面标题独立可辨**，面包屑为 **「Reports & Data / Annual Reports」**，正文含内嵌 PDF 阅读器（「It appears you do not have PDF support… Click here to download the document」），**即行业统计以 PDF 形式发布**；**理赔结算统计页 `/claims-statistics/`** 36KB，标题为「Claims Settlement Statistics - Insurance Regulatory Authority」，页内含 **From / To 时间范围 + 关键词**的查询表单（**统计查询界面**）；**年报页 `/annual-reports/`** 36KB，标题独立；首页导航另实测含 **Licensed Entities（持牌机构）、All Downloads、Standardized Insurance Policies（标准化保单）、Legal Notices** 等入口。⚠️ **本轮同时抓到一个真实陷阱并如实记录**：我原本以为存在的 `/industry-statistics/` 与 `/statistics/` **返回 200 但标题退化为站名（Insurance Regulatory Authority）**，属**软 404（模板页）**——**已从词条中剔除，不作为可用入口**；仅保留标题可辨、内容独立的页面。

对 RIAA：**① 补上非洲（除南非外）这一整块空白**——池内监管数据源覆盖美/欧/英/澳/日/韩/台/港/内地/印/新/马/加/菲/印尼，本轮又补了土耳其（[[seddk]]）与南非（[[fsca]]、[[assa]]），**肯尼亚是东非最大市场**；**② 「理赔结算统计」这一维度在池内罕见**——多数监管源只给保费与资产负债表层面数据，而 IRA 提供**按期间的理赔结算统计查询**，这对**理赔时效、赔付行为与消费者保护**方向的研究直接有用（可与 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的「理赔时限」口径对照：一个给时限规则、一个给结算统计）；**③ 市场结构与发展议题**——肯尼亚是**移动端小额保险与参数险**的重要试验场，与 [[openimis]]（开源保险管理系统，广泛用于非洲社会健康保护）、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 等条目构成「**新兴市场 + 气候/农业风险 + 数字渠道**」的组合；**④** 跨市场对照见 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题可辨与页面结构（含内嵌 PDF 阅读器与查询表单）**，**但未下载或打开任何 PDF，也未实际执行理赔统计查询**，因此**不能确认数据口径与质量**；**② 站点存在软 404**——若干猜测路径返回 200 但为通用模板（已识别并剔除），**后续引用该站时需以标题可辨为准**；**③** 行业统计以 **PDF**（而非结构化数据文件）发布，**机器可读性有限**；**④** 本站为**监管机构站点**，**不提供精算方法或工具**。**核实说明**：首页（51KB）、行业统计 2025 新闻稿页（28.7KB，标题独立、含 PDF 内嵌）、理赔结算统计页（36KB，含查询表单）、年报页（36KB，标题独立）均 HTTP 200 实测；**两个软 404 路径已实测识别并如实记录**；**未下载任何 PDF、未执行查询**。
e.body_en:
**IRA (Insurance Regulatory Authority)** is **Kenya’s insurance regulator** — the supervisor of East Africa’s largest insurance market. This entry also comes from the current **market-coverage axis**: a measured search found **zero Kenya-related entries and zero Africa-outside-South-Africa entries** (only synthetic-data items such as [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200, with real pages distinguished from soft 404s**): homepage 51KB; a **"Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025"** page (`/resource/press-release-industry-statistics-2025`) at 28.7KB with a **distinct page title**, breadcrumb "**Reports & Data / Annual Reports**", and an embedded PDF viewer ("It appears you do not have PDF support… Click here to download the document") — i.e. **industry statistics are published as a PDF**; a **claims settlement statistics page `/claims-statistics/`** at 36KB titled "Claims Settlement Statistics - Insurance Regulatory Authority", containing **From / To period plus keyword** query fields (a **statistics query interface**); an **annual reports page `/annual-reports/`** at 36KB with its own title; and homepage navigation showing **Licensed Entities, All Downloads, Standardized Insurance Policies and Legal Notices**. ⚠️ **This round also caught a real trap, recorded honestly**: two paths I had assumed existed — `/industry-statistics/` and `/statistics/` — **return 200 but with the title degraded to the site name (Insurance Regulatory Authority)**, i.e. **soft 404 template pages**; **they were removed from the entry and are not presented as usable entry points**, leaving only pages with distinct titles and independent content.

For RIAA: **① it fills the whole "Africa outside South Africa" gap** — the corpus’s regulator sources cover the US, EU, UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia, and this round added Turkey ([[seddk]]) and South Africa ([[fsca]], [[assa]]), while **Kenya is East Africa’s largest market**; **② the "claims settlement statistics" dimension is rare in this corpus** — most regulator sources give only premium and balance-sheet level data, whereas IRA provides a **period-based query over claims settlement statistics**, directly useful for research on **claims timeliness, payout behaviour and consumer protection** (it can be read against the claims-deadline angle of [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]: one gives deadline rules, the other settlement statistics); **③ market structure and development themes** — Kenya is an important testing ground for **mobile microinsurance and parametric cover**, so it sits with [[openimis]] (open-source insurance management widely used for social health protection in Africa), [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[agrisky-ai]] as an "**emerging market plus climate/agricultural risk plus digital channel**" combination; **④** cross-market comparisons: [[iais-icp]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, distinct titles and page structure (including the embedded PDF viewer and the query form)** but **downloaded and opened no PDF and did not run any claims query**, so **the data definitions and quality cannot be confirmed**; **② the site contains soft 404s** — several guessed paths returned 200 as generic templates (identified and excluded); **when citing this site, treat a distinct title as the test of a real page**; **③** industry statistics are released as **PDF** rather than structured data files, so **machine readability is limited**; **④** this is a **regulator site and offers no actuarial methods or tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (51KB), the Industry Statistics 2025 release page (28.7KB, distinct title, embedded PDF), the claims settlement statistics page (36KB, with query form) and the annual reports page (36KB, distinct title) were all measured at HTTP 200; **the two soft-404 paths were measured, identified and recorded**; **no PDF was downloaded and no query was run**.
e.body_hk:
**IRA（Insurance Regulatory Authority，肯尼亞保險監管局）** 是**肯尼亞的保險監管機構**——東非最大保險市場的監管者。本條目同屬本輪**市場覆蓋軸**：實測池內**肯尼亞及「南非以外的非洲」相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測，並逐一區分真頁面與軟 404**）：首頁 51KB；**「Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025」**頁 28.7KB，**標題獨立可辨**，麵包屑為 **「Reports & Data / Annual Reports」**，正文含內嵌 PDF 閱讀器——**即行業統計以 PDF 形式發布**；**理賠結算統計頁** 36KB，標題「Claims Settlement Statistics」，頁內含 **From / To 時間範圍 + 關鍵詞**查詢表單；**年報頁** 36KB，標題獨立；首頁導航另實測含 **Licensed Entities、All Downloads、Standardized Insurance Policies、Legal Notices**。⚠️ **本輪抓到一個真實陷阱並如實記錄**：原以為存在的 `/industry-statistics/` 與 `/statistics/` **返回 200 但標題退化為站名**，屬**軟 404（模板頁）**——**已從詞條剔除**，僅保留標題可辨、內容獨立者。

對 RIAA：**① 補上非洲（除南非外）這一整塊空白**；**② 「理賠結算統計」在池內罕見**——多數監管源只給保費與資產負債表層面，而 IRA 提供**按期間的理賠結算統計查詢**，對**理賠時效、賠付行為與消費者保護**方向直接有用（可與 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的「理賠時限」口徑對照）；**③** 肯尼亞是**移動端小額保險與參數險**的重要試驗場，與 [[openimis]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 構成「新興市場 + 氣候/農業風險 + 數字渠道」組合；**④** 跨市場對照見 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題可辨與頁面結構**，**但未下載或打開任何 PDF、也未實際執行查詢**；**② 站點存在軟 404**（已識別並剔除），**後續引用需以標題可辨為準**；**③** 行業統計以 **PDF** 發布，**機器可讀性有限**；**④** 本站為**監管機構站點，不提供精算方法或工具**。**核實說明**：首頁、行業統計 2025 頁、理賠結算統計頁、年報頁均 HTTP 200 實測；**兩個軟 404 路徑已實測識別並如實記錄**；**未下載任何 PDF、未執行查詢**。
